build_evaluate_package: build the evaluate python package with setuptools and publish to pypi
install_evaluate_with_deps: install the evaluate package with required dependencies like datasets numpy and huggingface-hub
install_evaluate_with_extras: install the evaluate package with optional extras like tensorflow torch dev or evaluator
run_evaluate_cli: run the evaluate-cli console script entry point for command-line evaluation tasks
test_evaluate_package: test the evaluate package with pytest and test dependencies including tensorflow and torch
